why.org_b:finding:06524: Enables internet-exposed remote code execution on zephyr-harbor-dmz-224 leading directly to the primary attack path to the warehouse.
why.org_b:finding:06523: Provides an alternative internet-exposed entry point into swift-meadow-dmz-223 leading toward the crown jewel.
why.org_b:finding:06521: Provides an internet-exposed entry point on zephyr-falcon-dmz-222 leading to secondary attack paths.
why.org_b:finding:06548: Exposes ember-cinder-dmz-227 to remote exploitation from the internet.
why.org_b:finding:06525: Enables local privilege escalation on zephyr-harbor-dmz-224 to access the SSH key needed to pivot deeper.
why.org_b:finding:06522: Allows remote service exploitation from zephyr-falcon-dmz-222 to pivot to internal data assets.
why.org_b:finding:06549: Permits remote service exploitation from ember-cinder-dmz-227 to internal data systems.

reasoning: To secure the warehouse crown jewel, we must cut all attack paths originating from the internet. The primary and alternative paths rely on internet-exposed vulnerabilities (findings 06524, 06523, 06521, and 06548). Fixing these four edge-facing findings completely disconnects the attacker from reaching the internal databases and data stores.
